proposed_decisions: Mostowski's truth-value glyphs vee/wedge and his bar for cardinality are source-local roles scoped to def:p03-w03-p03-042-truth-values (overlap with the connectives and with house |.| cardinality).
Mostowski's P (at most denumerably many) is a quantifier symbol scoped to def:p03-w03-p03-042-examples; it overlaps other P roles.
I_0 is used by Mostowski both for the integers (section 4) and for the denumerable hull (section 5); both kept, scoped to their definitions.
Q^H in def:p03-w03-p03-042-mundici-po-quantifier has the same glyph and meaning as def:p03-w03-p03-044-qh (sibling packet 044); propose one registry row with both scopes.
The comparison <= / == between logics (def:p03-w03-p03-042-mundici-comparison) overlaps the numeric order glyph; scoped to that convention.
Q_alpha in def:p03-w03-p03-042-mundici-comparison agrees with Q_1 of def:p03-q-one at alpha = 1; propose noting the family in the registry row of Q_1.
